context: Asuka lectures on putting ethics into practice.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: ethics lecture; vocabulary (相当/ざる/いただく/実践/受ける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 倫理は、実践してこそ価値があります。
lines.en: Ethics has value only when practiced.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実践は、相当難しそうですね。
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 相当な努力が、要ると認めざるを得ません。
lines.en: I can't deny it takes considerable effort.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生の助言を、いただけますか?
lines.style: polite adult student voice, soft warm earnest throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 喜んで。まず、小さな実践から受け止めましょう。
lines.en: Gladly. First, take on small practices.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 影響を受ける人を、考えるんですね。
lines.en: We consider those who are affected.
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、その視点は欠かせざるものです。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 助言をいただけて、相当助かりました。
lines.style: grateful adult student voice, soft warm appreciative closing throughout
